method: Read production controller/file contracts/resource service and prototype/P1 evidence. No new test was run: the already archived real fallback matrix was sufficient for that branch. No product/source modifications during r4 freeze.
productionFindings: No adapter manifest registration or production resources/list/read/write session host found in file controller/shared route/file service.

nextWork: Implement the already approved adapter manifest/configuration, session-scoped resource authorization and isolated host lifecycle before formal F28/J12 integration. Preserve unresolved state and denominator.
